concepts.learning_objective: Describe the mother's inability to love and the family's social pretensions.
Explain how the unspoken demand for money haunts the house and the children.
Explain the mother's idea of luck and how it differs from money.
Analyse why Paul sets out to prove that he is lucky.
Describe Paul's frenzied rides on the rocking-horse in search of luck.
Explain the secret betting partnership between Paul and Bassett.

topics.title: Winning at the Lincoln and the Leger

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how Paul's tip on Daffodil convinces Uncle Oscar.
Calculate winnings from the odds and stakes mentioned in the story.
Interpret Paul's claim that he wins only when he is 'sure'.

topics.title: The birthday gift and the louder voices

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the plan to give the mother money secretly and her response to it.
Analyse why the voices in the house grow louder after the money arrives.

topics.title: The Derby, Malabar and Paul's death

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the events leading to Paul's collapse and the Derby win.
Evaluate the irony of the ending and the symbolism of the rocking-horse.
Explain idioms and phrases such as 'sure as eggs', 'spinning yarns' and 'turned to dust'.
Identify the meanings of words for facial expressions and other words from the story.
